case.question: What capability would maximally enable several prioritized deployed Artemis III investigations?
case.gold_answer: A long-lived power source and communications capability would maximally enable several prioritized deployed investigations.

retrieved.title: Retrieved 1: artemis_power_communications | Long-lived power and communications
retrieved.text: Several prioritized Artemis III investigations would be maximally enabled by a long-lived power source and communications capability for deployed experiments.

retrieved.title: Retrieved 2: artemis_prioritization_method | Investigation prioritization
retrieved.text: The Science Definition Team prioritized investigations by considering both compelling science and whether Artemis III presented an enabling opportunity.

retrieved.title: Retrieved 3: artemis_science_objectives | Seven Artemis III science objectives
retrieved.text: The seven overarching Artemis III science objectives are understanding planetary processes, understanding the character and origin of lunar polar volatiles, interpreting the impact history of the Earth-Moon system, revealing the record of the ancient sun and astronomical environment, observing the universe and local space environment from a unique location, conducting experimental science in the lunar environment, and investigating and mitigating exploration risks.
